import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const sourceTopic = new tencentcloud.cls.Topic("source_topic", {

    storageType: "hot",
});
const targetLogset = new tencentcloud.cls.Logset("target_logset", {logsetName: "tf-example-target-logset"});

    period: 10,
    storageType: "hot",
});
const example = new tencentcloud.cls.DeliverTask("example", {
    taskName: "tf-example-deliver-task",
    compliance: 1,
    sourceTopicConfig: {

        logsetId: sourceLogset.id,
        topics: [{
            topicId: sourceTopic.id,
        }],
    },
    targetTopicConfig: {
        accountType: 1,
        region: "ap-guangzhou",
        logsetId: targetLogset.id,
        topicId: targetTopic.id,
    },
    deliverRule: {
        dataScope: 3,
    },
});

			return err
		}
		targetTopic, err := cls.NewTopic(ctx, "target_topic", &cls.TopicArgs{
			TopicName:   pulumi.String("tf-example-target-topic"),
			LogsetId:    targetLogset.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Period:      pulumi.Int(10),
			StorageType: pulumi.String("hot"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = cls.NewDeliverTask(ctx, "example", &cls.DeliverTaskArgs{
			TaskName:   pulumi.String("tf-example-deliver-task"),
			Compliance: pulumi.Int(1),
			SourceTopicConfig: &cls.DeliverTaskSourceTopicConfigArgs{
				TopicFilterType: pulumi.Int(1),

			},

				DataScope: pulumi.Int(3),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {

	})
}

package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.Logset;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.LogsetArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.Topic;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.TopicArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.DeliverTask;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.DeliverTaskArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.inputs.DeliverTaskSourceTopicConfigArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.inputs.DeliverTaskSourceTopicConfigTopicArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.inputs.DeliverTaskTargetTopicConfigArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cls.inputs.DeliverTaskDeliverRuleArgs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        var sourceLogset = new Logset("sourceLogset", LogsetArgs.builder()
            .logsetName("tf-example-source-logset")
            .build());

        var sourceTopic = new Topic("sourceTopic", TopicArgs.builder()
            .topicName("tf-example-source-topic")
            .logsetId(sourceLogset.id())
            .period(10)
            .storageType("hot")
            .build());

        var targetLogset = new Logset("targetLogset", LogsetArgs.builder()
            .logsetName("tf-example-target-logset")
            .build());

        var targetTopic = new Topic("targetTopic", TopicArgs.builder()
            .topicName("tf-example-target-topic")
            .logsetId(targetLogset.id())
            .period(10)
            .storageType("hot")
            .build());

        var example = new DeliverTask("example", DeliverTaskArgs.builder()
            .taskName("tf-example-deliver-task")
            .compliance(1)
            .sourceTopicConfig(DeliverTaskSourceTopicConfigArgs.builder()
                .topicFilterType(1)
                .logsetId(sourceLogset.id())
                .topics(DeliverTaskSourceTopicConfigTopicArgs.builder()
                    .topicId(sourceTopic.id())
                    .build())
                .build())
            .targetTopicConfig(DeliverTaskTargetTopicConfigArgs.builder()
                .accountType(1)
                .region("ap-guangzhou")
                .logsetId(targetLogset.id())
                .topicId(targetTopic.id())
                .build())
            .deliverRule(DeliverTaskDeliverRuleArgs.builder()
                .dataScope(3)
                .build())
            .build());

    }
}

## Import



CLS deliver task can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cls/deliverTask:DeliverTask example 42aa917e-a14d-4531-bbf1-0468e32e87f3
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
